services.name: jet ski
services.desc: Salt River Project and the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation are lowering Canyon Lake about 54 feet for scheduled dam safety inspections and maintenance at Mormon Flat and Horse Mesa dams. Tonto National Forest will close the lake, including all boat ramps and access points. Work begins September 16 and runs about 16 weeks, so the lake is expected to stay closed into late 2026 or early 2027. Labor Day weekend, September 4 through 7, is the last weekend to ride Canyon Lake before it closes. We are still renting. Saguaro Lake is not part of the closure, and the Bulldog Canyon trails do not need a lake at all. Pickup is from Apache Junction and all safety gear is included. Closure dates come from

services.name: pontoon
services.desc: The Sea-Doo Switch is as easy to captain as a jet ski! 21 feet of fun with room for the whole party. Bluetooth stereo, tubes, and lily pad available. Pickup at our Apache Junction base - just 15 min to Canyon Lake, 30 min to Saguaro Lake. The Sea-Doo Switch is as easy to captain as a jet ski - seriously! If you've ever ridden a jet ski, you'll feel right at home. With 21 feet of deck space and seating for 10, there's plenty of room for the whole party. Crank up the Bluetooth stereo and cruise to your favorite cove. We can also provide tubes and a lily pad for extra fun on the water. services.name: Paddleboard rental
services.desc: Stand-up paddleboards from $45 for a half day. Grab a board, bring the dog, and float past wild horses on the Salt River. Plus tax. A $150 refundable deposit per board comes back the same day you return it. Holiday weekends carry a 20% surcharge. Every rental comes with the board, an adjustable paddle, a leash, and a life jacket, plus a quick land lesson at pickup if it's your first time.
